nodes.g: Ziha = "parched" ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned from exile in Babylon…
Merari = "bitter" the 3rd son of Levi and head of a Levitical family
Hasupha or Hashupha = "stripped" head of the family of temple slaves returning from exile…
Hatita = "exploring" head of a family of Levitical porters or gate-keepers who returned…
Gispa = "caress" an officer of the temple slaves returning from exile with Nehemiah
